# Imagine reference acknowledgement

Source: https://github.com/lzhhhhc/imagine
Inspected commit: dc6d5bef11aba94323112f5429ffb3d83ac6e341
License: MIT; original license and third-party notices retained in LICENSE.

Eta independently implements protocol planning inspired by Imagine's separation of OpenAI Images,
JSON image-edit extensions, explicit target dimensions, and native NovelAI request/response handling.
No UI, automatic retry/resize/crop logic, character-workspace implementation, or st-chatu8 source is included.
Eta differs by rejecting approximate size conversions and preserving original returned images.
